title: Operationalization pathway for Private/VPC quarterly waves
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Define and sequence a repeatable quarterly operationalization pathway for Private (VPC/on‑prem) customers. This ticket captures the end-to-end wave plan: onboarding acceptance criteria, upgrade window gating, compliance checklist, operational runbooks, and the minimum product improvements required to reduce time-to-production for the Sales onboarding funnel. Goal: reduce average handoff time by 30% and enable 2 concurrent private wave rollouts per quarter by the end of Q2.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook templates (onboarding, upgrade, rollback) published in Confluence and linked from Console
Gating checklist implemented in Console for wave start with automated preflight checks
Two pilot customers complete full onboarding in staging and production within the wave timeline
SLA and escalation playbook validated with Support + SRE and documented
Operational metrics dashboard created (time-to-provision, MTTR for private upgrades, rollout success rate)
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with PM/Eng/Design; aligned on success metrics and high-level wave cadence
2026-02-20: Draft runbook outline reviewed by SRE; added preflight KV cache capacity check and GPU compatibility matrix
2026-02-26: Legal flagged additional data residency checklist items; added to compliance column
2026-03-01: Eng spike started to prototype Console gating UI and API for preflight checks (ENG-22107 linked)
2026-03-05: Stakeholder sync — prioritizing rollout automation stories for first sprint; updated acceptance criteria
decisions: Implement gating as a Console-first feature rather than CLI-only to reduce friction for sales-led onboarding
Ship a lightweight preflight API that surfaces pass/fail signals; defer full remediation tooling to a follow-up quarter
Quantize the initial scope to support common GPU families and two major Linux distros for wave 1 to limit risk
Opted for ‘canary wave’ pattern: 1 internal pilot + 1 early-customer pilot before broad wave open
related_metrics: OKR: Reduce enterprise private onboarding time by 30% (Q2)
Metric: Number of rollouts per quarter
rollout_plan: Wave 0 (internal): internal infra + SRE validation — March week 2
Wave 1 (pilot): 1 strategic customer on VPC — March week 4
Wave 2 (early customers): up to 3 customers, include on‑prem variant — April weeks 2–4
Wave 3 (broad): open intake with Scheduled wave windows and automated gating — May
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Compatibility failures on uncommon GPU families — Mitigation: restrict to validated GPU families and provide compatibility matrix
Risk: Legal/compliance delays on data residency — Mitigation: parallelize checklist completion with preflight checks and surface blockers early
Risk: SRE bandwidth for pilot support — Mitigation: dedicate a runbook owner and schedule on-call overlap during wave windows
next_steps: Finalize runbook templates and publish to Confluence (owner: Marcus)
Deliver Console gating API spike and initial UI mockups (owner: ENG; design review on 2026-03-10)
Schedule internal pilot and reserve SRE support rotations (owner: SRE)
Confirm pilot customers and align legal/compliance signoffs (owner: Sales Ops)
